   shape c3-highcpu-8, hyperdisk-balanced 100 GB (iops 20000, throughput 800 MiB/s), image projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/ubuntu-2404-noble-amd64-v20261105
   labels benchmark=1,network=bench,bench-run=r20991231-0101,tn-role=probe; results benchmark/results/r20991231-0101/probe/
   deadlines: run 120 min, arm 900 s, ssh ready 300 s, delete 300 s each

     g0-baseline            --arm 1 --preload-gb 6 --outputs 40 --warmup 3

== run: 19 arm(s), each under a 900-s watchdog; the run ends by start + 120 min
-- upload the bundle and settle the VM
  + [alarm 300s] gcloud compute scp \<bundle:\ \<--bin\>\,\ tools/folio-census.py\,\ node-persist-sampler.sh\,\ SHA256SUMS\>.tar.gz bench-probe-r20991231-0101:/tmp/bench-probe-bundle.tar.gz --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --scp-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20
  + [alarm 900s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<setup.sh
----- remote script setup -----
# setup: settle the fresh VM, unpack and check the bundle, check the tools the arms use
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
fail(){ echo "SETUP_FAIL $*"; exit 1; }
r=0; timeout 300 cloud-init status --wait >/dev/null 2>&1 || r=$?
echo "SETUP_NOTE cloud-init rc=$r"
s="$(timeout 300 systemctl is-system-running --wait 2>/dev/null)" || true
echo "SETUP_NOTE system=${s:-unknown}"
# The arms need a disk-quiet VM: the package timers would write during an arm.
for u in apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer apt-daily.service apt-daily-upgrade.service unattended-upgrades.service; do
    systemctl stop "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
done
mkdir -p "$B/bin" "$B/data" "$B/arms" || fail "mkdir $B"
tar -xzf /tmp/bench-probe-bundle.tar.gz -C "$B/bin" || fail "cannot unpack /tmp/bench-probe-bundle.tar.gz"
( cd "$B/bin" && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS ) || fail "bundle checksums differ"
chmod 0755 "$B/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe" "$B/bin/node-persist-sampler.sh"
for t in python3 fincore systemd-run findmnt lsblk timeout sha256sum; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "no $t"; done
"$B/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe" --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "the probe binary does not start here (glibc?)"
echo "SETUP_OK kernel=$(uname -r)"
----- end setup -----
-- host probe (bench_host_probe_script)
  + [alarm 120s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<host-probe.sh
----- remote script host-probe -----
mkdir -p /var/lib/bench-probe/data
# >>> bench-lib: bench_host_probe_script
<rendered by bench-lib.sh>
# <<< bench-lib: bench_host_probe_script
----- end host-probe -----
== arm g0-baseline: --arm 1 --preload-gb 6 --outputs 40 --warmup 3
  + [alarm 180s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g0-baseline-start.sh
----- remote script arm-g0-baseline-start -----
# arm g0-baseline: start (returns at once; the arm runs in its own unit)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g0-baseline
if [ -e "$A/started" ]; then echo "ARM_START g0-baseline already"; exit 0; fi
mkdir -p "$A/results" "$A/persist" || { echo "ARM_START g0-baseline failed mkdir"; exit 1; }
DEV="$(findmnt -no SOURCE --target "$B/data")"
DISK="$(lsblk -no PKNAME "$DEV" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
[ -n "$DISK" ] || DISK="${DEV#/dev/}"
case "$DISK" in ''|*[!a-z0-9]*) echo "ARM_START g0-baseline failed disk '$DISK'"; exit 1 ;; esac
# >>> bench-lib: bench_host_step_script read-ahead-kb <boot value>
<rendered by bench-lib.sh>
# <<< bench-lib: bench_host_step_script
[ "$HOST_STEP_RC" = 0 ] || { echo "ARM_START g0-baseline failed host step"; exit 1; }
cat > "$A/unit.sh" <<'PROBE_UNIT'
#!/bin/bash
# probe arm g0-baseline: run by systemd-run as bench-probe-arm-g0-baseline; $1 = the disk under /var/lib/bench-probe/data
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g0-baseline
cd "$A" || exit 1
date +%s > "$A/start"
/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 1 --preload-gb 6 --outputs 40 --warmup 3 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g0-baseline --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk "$1" > "$A/probe.log" 2>&1 &
p=$!
echo "$p" > "$A/probe.pid"
( sleep 900; if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo 1 > "$A/timed_out"; kill -TERM "$p"; sleep 30; kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi ) &
w=$!
rc=0
wait "$p" || rc=$?
kill "$w" 2>/dev/null
date +%s > "$A/end"
echo "$rc" > "$A/rc"
touch "$A/done"
PROBE_UNIT
echo "/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 1 --preload-gb 6 --outputs 40 --warmup 3 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g0-baseline --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk $DISK" > "$A/cmd.txt"
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-sampler-g0-baseline --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1500 \
    /usr/bin/env PERSIST_PID_FILE=$A/probe.pid PERSIST_MDBX_FILE=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g0-baseline/mdbx.dat PERSIST_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/bench-probe/data \
    PERSIST_OUT_DIR=$A/persist PERSIST_HOST=g0-baseline PERSIST_INTERVAL_SECS=10 PERSIST_MDBX_EVERY_SECS=30 \
    PERSIST_CENSUS_EVERY_SECS=60 PERSIST_CENSUS=/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/folio-census.py PERSIST_METRICS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/metrics \
    /bin/bash /var/lib/bench-probe/bin/node-persist-sampler.sh || { echo "ARM_START g0-baseline failed sampler"; exit 1; }
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-arm-g0-baseline --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1200 \
    /bin/bash "$A/unit.sh" "$DISK" || { systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g0-baseline; echo "ARM_START g0-baseline failed unit"; exit 1; }
date +%s > "$A/started"
echo "ARM_START g0-baseline ok disk=$DISK unix=$(cat "$A/started")"
----- end arm-g0-baseline-start -----
  + [alarm 420s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g0-baseline-wait.sh
----- remote script arm-g0-baseline-wait -----
# arm g0-baseline: wait (at most 300 s in this session)
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g0-baseline
t0=$(date +%s); k=0
while :; do
    if [ -e "$A/done" ]; then
        echo "ARM_DONE g0-baseline rc=$(cat "$A/rc" 2>/dev/null) timed_out=$(cat "$A/timed_out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) start=$(cat "$A/start" 2>/dev/null) end=$(cat "$A/end" 2>/dev/null)"
        exit 0
    fi
    if ! systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g0-baseline; then
        sleep 2; [ -e "$A/done" ] && continue
        echo "ARM_LOST g0-baseline"; exit 0
    fi
    e=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    [ "$e" -lt 300 ] || { echo "ARM_WAIT g0-baseline running"; exit 0; }
    k=$((k + 1)); [ $(( k % 6 )) -ne 0 ] || echo "ARM_WAIT g0-baseline elapsed=$e"
    sleep 5
done
----- end arm-g0-baseline-wait -----
  + [alarm 300s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g0-baseline-finish.sh
----- remote script arm-g0-baseline-finish -----
# arm g0-baseline: finish (stop a late arm and the sampler, remove the DB, tar for the pull)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g0-baseline
D=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g0-baseline
if systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g0-baseline; then systemctl stop bench-probe-arm-g0-baseline; echo "ARM_FINISH g0-baseline stopped the running arm"; fi
systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g0-baseline >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p "$A"
journalctl -u bench-probe-sampler-g0-baseline -u bench-probe-arm-g0-baseline --no-pager -o short-iso > "$A/journal.txt" 2>&1 || true
rm -f -- "$D/mdbx.dat" "$D/mdbx.lck" "$D/probe-meta.txt" "$B/data/g0-baseline.appender.log"
rmdir -- "$D" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -e "$D/mdbx.dat" ]; then echo "ARM_FINISH g0-baseline could not remove $D/mdbx.dat"; fi
T=/var/tmp/bench-probe-g0-baseline.tar.gz
tar -C "$B/arms" -czf "$T" g0-baseline || { echo "ARM_TAR g0-baseline failed"; exit 1; }
chmod 0644 "$T"
echo "ARM_TAR g0-baseline bytes=$(stat -c %s "$T") sha256=$(sha256sum "$T" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
----- end arm-g0-baseline-finish -----
  + [alarm 300s x3] gcloud compute scp bench-probe-r20991231-0101:/var/tmp/bench-probe-g0-baseline.tar.gz benchmark/results/r20991231-0101/probe/arms/g0-baseline.tar.gz --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --scp-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20

# arm g2-readall: start (returns at once; the arm runs in its own unit)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g2-readall
if [ -e "$A/started" ]; then echo "ARM_START g2-readall already"; exit 0; fi
mkdir -p "$A/results" "$A/persist" || { echo "ARM_START g2-readall failed mkdir"; exit 1; }

p=$!
echo "$p" > "$A/probe.pid"

----- remote script arm-g2-readall-wait -----
# arm g2-readall: wait (at most 300 s in this session)
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g2-readall
t0=$(date +%s); k=0
while :; do
    if [ -e "$A/done" ]; then
        echo "ARM_DONE g2-readall rc=$(cat "$A/rc" 2>/dev/null) timed_out=$(cat "$A/timed_out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) start=$(cat "$A/start" 2>/dev/null) end=$(cat "$A/end" 2>/dev/null)"
        exit 0
    fi
    if ! systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g2-readall; then
        sleep 2; [ -e "$A/done" ] && continue
        echo "ARM_LOST g2-readall"; exit 0
    fi
    e=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    [ "$e" -lt 300 ] || { echo "ARM_WAIT g2-readall running"; exit 0; }
    k=$((k + 1)); [ $(( k % 6 )) -ne 0 ] || echo "ARM_WAIT g2-readall elapsed=$e"
    sleep 5
done
----- end arm-g2-readall-wait -----
  + [alarm 300s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g2-readall-finish.sh
----- remote script arm-g2-readall-finish -----
# arm g2-readall: finish (stop a late arm and the sampler, remove the DB, tar for the pull)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g2-readall
D=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g2-readall
if systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g2-readall; then systemctl stop bench-probe-arm-g2-readall; echo "ARM_FINISH g2-readall stopped the running arm"; fi
systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g2-readall >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p "$A"
journalctl -u bench-probe-sampler-g2-readall -u bench-probe-arm-g2-readall --no-pager -o short-iso > "$A/journal.txt" 2>&1 || true
rm -f -- "$D/mdbx.dat" "$D/mdbx.lck" "$D/probe-meta.txt" "$B/data/g2-readall.appender.log"
rmdir -- "$D" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -e "$D/mdbx.dat" ]; then echo "ARM_FINISH g2-readall could not remove $D/mdbx.dat"; fi
T=/var/tmp/bench-probe-g2-readall.tar.gz
tar -C "$B/arms" -czf "$T" g2-readall || { echo "ARM_TAR g2-readall failed"; exit 1; }
chmod 0644 "$T"
echo "ARM_TAR g2-readall bytes=$(stat -c %s "$T") sha256=$(sha256sum "$T" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
----- end arm-g2-readall-finish -----
  + [alarm 300s x3] gcloud compute scp bench-probe-r20991231-0101:/var/tmp/bench-probe-g2-readall.tar.gz benchmark/results/r20991231-0101/probe/arms/g2-readall.tar.gz --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --scp-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20

# arm g4-mrand-readall: wait (at most 300 s in this session)

t0=$(date +%s); k=0
while :; do
    if [ -e "$A/done" ]; then
        echo "ARM_DONE g4-mrand-readall rc=$(cat "$A/rc" 2>/dev/null) timed_out=$(cat "$A/timed_out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) start=$(cat "$A/start" 2>/dev/null) end=$(cat "$A/end" 2>/dev/null)"
        exit 0
    fi
    if ! systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g4-mrand-readall; then
        sleep 2; [ -e "$A/done" ] && continue
        echo "ARM_LOST g4-mrand-readall"; exit 0
    fi
    e=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    [ "$e" -lt 300 ] || { echo "ARM_WAIT g4-mrand-readall running"; exit 0; }
    k=$((k + 1)); [ $(( k % 6 )) -ne 0 ] || echo "ARM_WAIT g4-mrand-readall elapsed=$e"
    sleep 5
done

# arm g4-mrand-readall: finish (stop a late arm and the sampler, remove the DB, tar for the pull)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g4-mrand-readall
D=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g4-mrand-readall
if systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g4-mrand-readall; then systemctl stop bench-probe-arm-g4-mrand-readall; echo "ARM_FINISH g4-mrand-readall stopped the running arm"; fi
systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g4-mrand-readall >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p "$A"
journalctl -u bench-probe-sampler-g4-mrand-readall -u bench-probe-arm-g4-mrand-readall --no-pager -o short-iso > "$A/journal.txt" 2>&1 || true
rm -f -- "$D/mdbx.dat" "$D/mdbx.lck" "$D/probe-meta.txt" "$B/data/g4-mrand-readall.appender.log"
rmdir -- "$D" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -e "$D/mdbx.dat" ]; then echo "ARM_FINISH g4-mrand-readall could not remove $D/mdbx.dat"; fi
T=/var/tmp/bench-probe-g4-mrand-readall.tar.gz
tar -C "$B/arms" -czf "$T" g4-mrand-readall || { echo "ARM_TAR g4-mrand-readall failed"; exit 1; }
chmod 0644 "$T"
echo "ARM_TAR g4-mrand-readall bytes=$(stat -c %s "$T") sha256=$(sha256sum "$T" | cut -d' ' -f1)"

    /usr/bin/env PERSIST_PID_FILE=$A/probe.pid PERSIST_MDBX_FILE=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g5-7pfoff-mrand/mdbx.dat PERSIST_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/bench-probe/data \
    PERSIST_OUT_DIR=$A/persist PERSIST_HOST=g5-7pfoff-mrand PERSIST_INTERVAL_SECS=10 PERSIST_MDBX_EVERY_SECS=30 \
    PERSIST_CENSUS_EVERY_SECS=60 PERSIST_CENSUS=/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/folio-census.py PERSIST_METRICS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/metrics \

----- remote script arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand-wait -----
# arm g5-7pfoff-mrand: wait (at most 300 s in this session)
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g5-7pfoff-mrand
t0=$(date +%s); k=0
while :; do
    if [ -e "$A/done" ]; then
        echo "ARM_DONE g5-7pfoff-mrand rc=$(cat "$A/rc" 2>/dev/null) timed_out=$(cat "$A/timed_out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) start=$(cat "$A/start" 2>/dev/null) end=$(cat "$A/end" 2>/dev/null)"
        exit 0
    fi
    if ! systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand; then
        sleep 2; [ -e "$A/done" ] && continue
        echo "ARM_LOST g5-7pfoff-mrand"; exit 0
    fi
    e=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    [ "$e" -lt 300 ] || { echo "ARM_WAIT g5-7pfoff-mrand running"; exit 0; }
    k=$((k + 1)); [ $(( k % 6 )) -ne 0 ] || echo "ARM_WAIT g5-7pfoff-mrand elapsed=$e"
    sleep 5
done
----- end arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand-wait -----

----- remote script arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand-finish -----
# arm g5-7pfoff-mrand: finish (stop a late arm and the sampler, remove the DB, tar for the pull)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g5-7pfoff-mrand
D=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g5-7pfoff-mrand
if systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand; then systemctl stop bench-probe-arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand; echo "ARM_FINISH g5-7pfoff-mrand stopped the running arm"; fi
systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g5-7pfoff-mrand >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p "$A"
journalctl -u bench-probe-sampler-g5-7pfoff-mrand -u bench-probe-arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand --no-pager -o short-iso > "$A/journal.txt" 2>&1 || true
rm -f -- "$D/mdbx.dat" "$D/mdbx.lck" "$D/probe-meta.txt" "$B/data/g5-7pfoff-mrand.appender.log"
rmdir -- "$D" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -e "$D/mdbx.dat" ]; then echo "ARM_FINISH g5-7pfoff-mrand could not remove $D/mdbx.dat"; fi
T=/var/tmp/bench-probe-g5-7pfoff-mrand.tar.gz
tar -C "$B/arms" -czf "$T" g5-7pfoff-mrand || { echo "ARM_TAR g5-7pfoff-mrand failed"; exit 1; }
chmod 0644 "$T"
echo "ARM_TAR g5-7pfoff-mrand bytes=$(stat -c %s "$T") sha256=$(sha256sum "$T" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
----- end arm-g5-7pfoff-mrand-finish -----

== arm g6-peer: --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --peer-open-at 60
  + [alarm 180s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g6-peer-start.sh
----- remote script arm-g6-peer-start -----
# arm g6-peer: start (returns at once; the arm runs in its own unit)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g6-peer
if [ -e "$A/started" ]; then echo "ARM_START g6-peer already"; exit 0; fi
mkdir -p "$A/results" "$A/persist" || { echo "ARM_START g6-peer failed mkdir"; exit 1; }
DEV="$(findmnt -no SOURCE --target "$B/data")"
DISK="$(lsblk -no PKNAME "$DEV" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
[ -n "$DISK" ] || DISK="${DEV#/dev/}"
case "$DISK" in ''|*[!a-z0-9]*) echo "ARM_START g6-peer failed disk '$DISK'"; exit 1 ;; esac
# >>> bench-lib: bench_host_step_script read-ahead-kb <boot value>
<rendered by bench-lib.sh>
# <<< bench-lib: bench_host_step_script
[ "$HOST_STEP_RC" = 0 ] || { echo "ARM_START g6-peer failed host step"; exit 1; }
cat > "$A/unit.sh" <<'PROBE_UNIT'
#!/bin/bash
# probe arm g6-peer: run by systemd-run as bench-probe-arm-g6-peer; $1 = the disk under /var/lib/bench-probe/data
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g6-peer
cd "$A" || exit 1
date +%s > "$A/start"
/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --peer-open-at 60 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g6-peer --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk "$1" > "$A/probe.log" 2>&1 &
p=$!
echo "$p" > "$A/probe.pid"
( sleep 900; if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo 1 > "$A/timed_out"; kill -TERM "$p"; sleep 30; kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi ) &
w=$!
rc=0
wait "$p" || rc=$?
kill "$w" 2>/dev/null
date +%s > "$A/end"
echo "$rc" > "$A/rc"
touch "$A/done"
PROBE_UNIT
echo "/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --peer-open-at 60 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g6-peer --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk $DISK" > "$A/cmd.txt"
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-sampler-g6-peer --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1500 \
    /usr/bin/env PERSIST_PID_FILE=$A/probe.pid PERSIST_MDBX_FILE=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g6-peer/mdbx.dat PERSIST_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/bench-probe/data \
    PERSIST_OUT_DIR=$A/persist PERSIST_HOST=g6-peer PERSIST_INTERVAL_SECS=10 PERSIST_MDBX_EVERY_SECS=30 \
    PERSIST_CENSUS_EVERY_SECS=60 PERSIST_CENSUS=/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/folio-census.py PERSIST_METRICS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/metrics \
    /bin/bash /var/lib/bench-probe/bin/node-persist-sampler.sh || { echo "ARM_START g6-peer failed sampler"; exit 1; }
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-arm-g6-peer --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1200 \
    /bin/bash "$A/unit.sh" "$DISK" || { systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g6-peer; echo "ARM_START g6-peer failed unit"; exit 1; }
date +%s > "$A/started"
echo "ARM_START g6-peer ok disk=$DISK unix=$(cat "$A/started")"
----- end arm-g6-peer-start -----

# arm g6-peer-mrand: wait (at most 300 s in this session)
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g6-peer-mrand
t0=$(date +%s); k=0
while :; do
    if [ -e "$A/done" ]; then
        echo "ARM_DONE g6-peer-mrand rc=$(cat "$A/rc" 2>/dev/null) timed_out=$(cat "$A/timed_out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) start=$(cat "$A/start" 2>/dev/null) end=$(cat "$A/end" 2>/dev/null)"
        exit 0
    fi
    if ! systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g6-peer-mrand; then
        sleep 2; [ -e "$A/done" ] && continue
        echo "ARM_LOST g6-peer-mrand"; exit 0
    fi
    e=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    [ "$e" -lt 300 ] || { echo "ARM_WAIT g6-peer-mrand running"; exit 0; }
    k=$((k + 1)); [ $(( k % 6 )) -ne 0 ] || echo "ARM_WAIT g6-peer-mrand elapsed=$e"
    sleep 5
done

----- remote script arm-g6-peer-mrand-finish -----
# arm g6-peer-mrand: finish (stop a late arm and the sampler, remove the DB, tar for the pull)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g6-peer-mrand
D=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g6-peer-mrand
if systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g6-peer-mrand; then systemctl stop bench-probe-arm-g6-peer-mrand; echo "ARM_FINISH g6-peer-mrand stopped the running arm"; fi
systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g6-peer-mrand >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p "$A"
journalctl -u bench-probe-sampler-g6-peer-mrand -u bench-probe-arm-g6-peer-mrand --no-pager -o short-iso > "$A/journal.txt" 2>&1 || true
rm -f -- "$D/mdbx.dat" "$D/mdbx.lck" "$D/probe-meta.txt" "$B/data/g6-peer-mrand.appender.log"
rmdir -- "$D" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -e "$D/mdbx.dat" ]; then echo "ARM_FINISH g6-peer-mrand could not remove $D/mdbx.dat"; fi
T=/var/tmp/bench-probe-g6-peer-mrand.tar.gz
tar -C "$B/arms" -czf "$T" g6-peer-mrand || { echo "ARM_TAR g6-peer-mrand failed"; exit 1; }
chmod 0644 "$T"
echo "ARM_TAR g6-peer-mrand bytes=$(stat -c %s "$T") sha256=$(sha256sum "$T" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
----- end arm-g6-peer-mrand-finish -----

== arm g7-ovf64: --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --overflow-per-tx 0.001 --overflow-value 258000
  + [alarm 180s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g7-ovf64-start.sh
----- remote script arm-g7-ovf64-start -----
# arm g7-ovf64: start (returns at once; the arm runs in its own unit)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g7-ovf64
if [ -e "$A/started" ]; then echo "ARM_START g7-ovf64 already"; exit 0; fi
mkdir -p "$A/results" "$A/persist" || { echo "ARM_START g7-ovf64 failed mkdir"; exit 1; }
DEV="$(findmnt -no SOURCE --target "$B/data")"
DISK="$(lsblk -no PKNAME "$DEV" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
[ -n "$DISK" ] || DISK="${DEV#/dev/}"
case "$DISK" in ''|*[!a-z0-9]*) echo "ARM_START g7-ovf64 failed disk '$DISK'"; exit 1 ;; esac
# >>> bench-lib: bench_host_step_script read-ahead-kb <boot value>
<rendered by bench-lib.sh>
# <<< bench-lib: bench_host_step_script
[ "$HOST_STEP_RC" = 0 ] || { echo "ARM_START g7-ovf64 failed host step"; exit 1; }
cat > "$A/unit.sh" <<'PROBE_UNIT'
#!/bin/bash
# probe arm g7-ovf64: run by systemd-run as bench-probe-arm-g7-ovf64; $1 = the disk under /var/lib/bench-probe/data
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g7-ovf64
cd "$A" || exit 1
date +%s > "$A/start"
/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --overflow-per-tx 0.001 --overflow-value 258000 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g7-ovf64 --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk "$1" > "$A/probe.log" 2>&1 &
p=$!
echo "$p" > "$A/probe.pid"
( sleep 900; if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo 1 > "$A/timed_out"; kill -TERM "$p"; sleep 30; kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi ) &
w=$!
rc=0
wait "$p" || rc=$?
kill "$w" 2>/dev/null
date +%s > "$A/end"
echo "$rc" > "$A/rc"
touch "$A/done"
PROBE_UNIT
echo "/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --overflow-per-tx 0.001 --overflow-value 258000 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g7-ovf64 --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk $DISK" > "$A/cmd.txt"
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-sampler-g7-ovf64 --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1500 \
    /usr/bin/env PERSIST_PID_FILE=$A/probe.pid PERSIST_MDBX_FILE=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g7-ovf64/mdbx.dat PERSIST_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/bench-probe/data \
    PERSIST_OUT_DIR=$A/persist PERSIST_HOST=g7-ovf64 PERSIST_INTERVAL_SECS=10 PERSIST_MDBX_EVERY_SECS=30 \
    PERSIST_CENSUS_EVERY_SECS=60 PERSIST_CENSUS=/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/folio-census.py PERSIST_METRICS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/metrics \
    /bin/bash /var/lib/bench-probe/bin/node-persist-sampler.sh || { echo "ARM_START g7-ovf64 failed sampler"; exit 1; }
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-arm-g7-ovf64 --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1200 \
    /bin/bash "$A/unit.sh" "$DISK" || { systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g7-ovf64; echo "ARM_START g7-ovf64 failed unit"; exit 1; }

----- remote script arm-g7-ovf8-wait -----
# arm g7-ovf8: wait (at most 300 s in this session)
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g7-ovf8
t0=$(date +%s); k=0
while :; do
    if [ -e "$A/done" ]; then
        echo "ARM_DONE g7-ovf8 rc=$(cat "$A/rc" 2>/dev/null) timed_out=$(cat "$A/timed_out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) start=$(cat "$A/start" 2>/dev/null) end=$(cat "$A/end" 2>/dev/null)"
        exit 0
    fi
    if ! systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g7-ovf8; then
        sleep 2; [ -e "$A/done" ] && continue
        echo "ARM_LOST g7-ovf8"; exit 0
    fi
    e=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    [ "$e" -lt 300 ] || { echo "ARM_WAIT g7-ovf8 running"; exit 0; }
    k=$((k + 1)); [ $(( k % 6 )) -ne 0 ] || echo "ARM_WAIT g7-ovf8 elapsed=$e"
    sleep 5
done
----- end arm-g7-ovf8-wait -----
  + [alarm 300s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g7-ovf8-finish.sh
----- remote script arm-g7-ovf8-finish -----
# arm g7-ovf8: finish (stop a late arm and the sampler, remove the DB, tar for the pull)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g7-ovf8
D=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g7-ovf8
if systemctl is-active --quiet bench-probe-arm-g7-ovf8; then systemctl stop bench-probe-arm-g7-ovf8; echo "ARM_FINISH g7-ovf8 stopped the running arm"; fi
systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g7-ovf8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p "$A"
journalctl -u bench-probe-sampler-g7-ovf8 -u bench-probe-arm-g7-ovf8 --no-pager -o short-iso > "$A/journal.txt" 2>&1 || true
rm -f -- "$D/mdbx.dat" "$D/mdbx.lck" "$D/probe-meta.txt" "$B/data/g7-ovf8.appender.log"
rmdir -- "$D" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -e "$D/mdbx.dat" ]; then echo "ARM_FINISH g7-ovf8 could not remove $D/mdbx.dat"; fi
T=/var/tmp/bench-probe-g7-ovf8.tar.gz
tar -C "$B/arms" -czf "$T" g7-ovf8 || { echo "ARM_TAR g7-ovf8 failed"; exit 1; }
chmod 0644 "$T"
echo "ARM_TAR g7-ovf8 bytes=$(stat -c %s "$T") sha256=$(sha256sum "$T" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
----- end arm-g7-ovf8-finish -----

== arm g7-longreader: --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --overflow-per-tx 0.05 --long-reader-at 60 --long-reader-for 60
  + [alarm 180s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g7-longreader-start.sh
----- remote script arm-g7-longreader-start -----
# arm g7-longreader: start (returns at once; the arm runs in its own unit)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g7-longreader
if [ -e "$A/started" ]; then echo "ARM_START g7-longreader already"; exit 0; fi
mkdir -p "$A/results" "$A/persist" || { echo "ARM_START g7-longreader failed mkdir"; exit 1; }
DEV="$(findmnt -no SOURCE --target "$B/data")"
DISK="$(lsblk -no PKNAME "$DEV" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
[ -n "$DISK" ] || DISK="${DEV#/dev/}"
case "$DISK" in ''|*[!a-z0-9]*) echo "ARM_START g7-longreader failed disk '$DISK'"; exit 1 ;; esac
# >>> bench-lib: bench_host_step_script read-ahead-kb <boot value>
<rendered by bench-lib.sh>
# <<< bench-lib: bench_host_step_script
[ "$HOST_STEP_RC" = 0 ] || { echo "ARM_START g7-longreader failed host step"; exit 1; }
cat > "$A/unit.sh" <<'PROBE_UNIT'
#!/bin/bash
# probe arm g7-longreader: run by systemd-run as bench-probe-arm-g7-longreader; $1 = the disk under /var/lib/bench-probe/data
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g7-longreader
cd "$A" || exit 1
date +%s > "$A/start"
/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --overflow-per-tx 0.05 --long-reader-at 60 --long-reader-for 60 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g7-longreader --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk "$1" > "$A/probe.log" 2>&1 &
p=$!
echo "$p" > "$A/probe.pid"
( sleep 900; if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo 1 > "$A/timed_out"; kill -TERM "$p"; sleep 30; kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi ) &
w=$!
rc=0
wait "$p" || rc=$?
kill "$w" 2>/dev/null
date +%s > "$A/end"
echo "$rc" > "$A/rc"
touch "$A/done"
PROBE_UNIT
echo "/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --overflow-per-tx 0.05 --long-reader-at 60 --long-reader-for 60 --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g7-longreader --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk $DISK" > "$A/cmd.txt"
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-sampler-g7-longreader --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1500 \
    /usr/bin/env PERSIST_PID_FILE=$A/probe.pid PERSIST_MDBX_FILE=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g7-longreader/mdbx.dat PERSIST_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/bench-probe/data \

        echo "ARM_LOST g8-nowritemap-readall"; exit 0
    fi

    k=$((k + 1)); [ $(( k % 6 )) -ne 0 ] || echo "ARM_WAIT g8-nowritemap-readall elapsed=$e"
    sleep 5

T=/var/tmp/bench-probe-g8-nowritemap-readall.tar.gz

== arm g9-sampler: --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --keep-db
  + [alarm 180s] gcloud compute ssh bench-probe-r20991231-0101 --zone=us-west2-a --project=<project> --tunnel-through-iap --ssh-flag=-o\ ConnectTimeout=20 --ssh-flag=-o\ StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new --ssh-flag=-T --command=sudo\ bash\ -s \<arm-g9-sampler-start.sh
----- remote script arm-g9-sampler-start -----
# arm g9-sampler: start (returns at once; the arm runs in its own unit)
set -u
B=/var/lib/bench-probe
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g9-sampler
if [ -e "$A/started" ]; then echo "ARM_START g9-sampler already"; exit 0; fi
mkdir -p "$A/results" "$A/persist" || { echo "ARM_START g9-sampler failed mkdir"; exit 1; }
DEV="$(findmnt -no SOURCE --target "$B/data")"
DISK="$(lsblk -no PKNAME "$DEV" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
[ -n "$DISK" ] || DISK="${DEV#/dev/}"
case "$DISK" in ''|*[!a-z0-9]*) echo "ARM_START g9-sampler failed disk '$DISK'"; exit 1 ;; esac
# >>> bench-lib: bench_host_step_script read-ahead-kb <boot value>
<rendered by bench-lib.sh>
# <<< bench-lib: bench_host_step_script
[ "$HOST_STEP_RC" = 0 ] || { echo "ARM_START g9-sampler failed host step"; exit 1; }
cat > "$A/unit.sh" <<'PROBE_UNIT'
#!/bin/bash
# probe arm g9-sampler: run by systemd-run as bench-probe-arm-g9-sampler; $1 = the disk under /var/lib/bench-probe/data
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g9-sampler
cd "$A" || exit 1
date +%s > "$A/start"
/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --keep-db --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g9-sampler --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk "$1" > "$A/probe.log" 2>&1 &
p=$!
echo "$p" > "$A/probe.pid"
( sleep 900; if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo 1 > "$A/timed_out"; kill -TERM "$p"; sleep 30; kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi ) &
w=$!
bash "$A/safety.sh" live "$p" > "$A/census-safety.txt" 2>&1 &
s=$!
rc=0
wait "$p" || rc=$?
kill "$w" 2>/dev/null
wait "$s"
bash "$A/safety.sh" quiet >> "$A/census-safety.txt" 2>&1
date +%s > "$A/end"
echo "$rc" > "$A/rc"
touch "$A/done"
PROBE_UNIT
cat > "$A/safety.sh" <<'PROBE_SAFETY'
#!/bin/bash
F=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g9-sampler/mdbx.dat
C=/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/folio-census.py
A=/var/lib/bench-probe/arms/g9-sampler
mode="$1"; p="${2:-}"
res() { timeout 20 fincore -n -r -o PAGES "$F" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '; }
rb() { local k v; while read -r k v; do if [ "$k" = read_bytes: ]; then echo "$v"; return; fi; done < "/proc/$$/io"; echo 0; }
# Warm-up outside the count: python3, the census's modules and fincore come off the disk once here (a
# census of the census script itself), so read_bytes below is what the censuses of mdbx.dat read.
timeout 60 python3 "$C" --file "$C" --header >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 20 fincore -n -r -o PAGES "$C" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ "$mode" = live ]; then
    n=0; while [ ! -e "$F" ] && [ "$n" -lt 300 ]; do sleep 5; n=$((n + 5)); done
    sleep 60
fi
io0="$(rb)"; runs=0; same=0
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    if [ "$mode" = live ] && ! kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "CENSUS_SAFETY $mode i=$i writer_gone"; break; fi
    b="$(res)"
    if [ "$mode" = live ]; then
        timeout 60 python3 "$C" --file "$F" --pid "$p" --header > "$A/census-$mode-$i.txt" 2>&1; crc=$?
    else
        timeout 60 python3 "$C" --file "$F" --header > "$A/census-$mode-$i.txt" 2>&1; crc=$?
    fi
    a="$(res)"
    runs=$((runs + 1))
    if [ -n "$b" ] && [ "$b" = "$a" ]; then same=$((same + 1)); fi
    echo "CENSUS_SAFETY $mode i=$i res_before=${b:--} res_after=${a:--} census_rc=$crc"
    if [ "$mode" = live ]; then sleep 10; fi
done
io1="$(rb)"
echo "CENSUS_SAFETY_IO $mode runs=$runs unchanged=$same read_bytes=$((io1 - io0))"
PROBE_SAFETY
echo "/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/mdbx-writeback-probe --arm 7 --preload-gb 0.05 --txs 2000 --outputs 240 --warmup 40 --pause-ms 500 --reader-hold 10 --keep-db --quiet-secs 10 --quiet-max-mbps 2 --quiet-retries 6 --quiet-wait-secs 20 --require-quiet --tag g9-sampler --data-dir /var/lib/bench-probe/data --results-dir $A/results --disk $DISK" > "$A/cmd.txt"
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-sampler-g9-sampler --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1500 \
    /usr/bin/env PERSIST_PID_FILE=$A/probe.pid PERSIST_MDBX_FILE=/var/lib/bench-probe/data/g9-sampler/mdbx.dat PERSIST_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/bench-probe/data \
    PERSIST_OUT_DIR=$A/persist PERSIST_HOST=g9-sampler PERSIST_INTERVAL_SECS=5 PERSIST_MDBX_EVERY_SECS=5 \
    PERSIST_CENSUS_EVERY_SECS=5 PERSIST_CENSUS=/var/lib/bench-probe/bin/folio-census.py PERSIST_METRICS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/metrics \
    /bin/bash /var/lib/bench-probe/bin/node-persist-sampler.sh || { echo "ARM_START g9-sampler failed sampler"; exit 1; }
systemd-run --unit=bench-probe-arm-g9-sampler --collect --quiet -p RuntimeMaxSec=1200 \
    /bin/bash "$A/unit.sh" "$DISK" || { systemctl stop bench-probe-sampler-g9-sampler; echo "ARM_START g9-sampler failed unit"; exit 1; }
date +%s > "$A/started"
echo "ARM_START g9-sampler ok disk=$DISK unix=$(cat "$A/started")"
----- end arm-g9-sampler-start -----
